cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises its arm to a welcoming height, then performs a friendly, rhythmic side-to-side waving motion, gradually slowing before returning to a relaxed position.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position, lifts smoothly to a clear acknowledgement height, holds briefly for punctuation, and then lowers back to a relaxed, settled position.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot's arm, simulating the upper body, performs a respectful forward and downward bow, holds briefly, and then smoothly returns to an upright, composed position.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot's arm extends smoothly forward and slightly upward from a neutral position, concluding with the gripper in a vertical orientation, held steady in a welcoming gesture for a handshake.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward to simulate engaging in a handshake, performs a vigorous up-and-down shaking motion with its wrist, then slowly reduces the intensity and retracts its arm.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position, lifting slightly and sweeping across its chest to mimic a comforting embrace. It holds this self-hug briefly before gently relaxing into a settled posture.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot arm starts from a neutral mid-chest position, gracefully lifts and bends to bring its fingertips close to its 'lips', holds momentarily, then executes a swift outward motion as if blowing a kiss, before settling back to a relaxed, slightly forward posture.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot arm gracefully rises to form a heart shape above its head, sweeping through an arc for the top curve and then descending to form the point, conveying affection and warmth.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot arm performs a gentle, controlled motion to place its hand softly over its chest, conveying sincerity or gratitude, ending with a deliberate hold and a slow, graceful withdrawal.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot arm starts in a neutral position, pulls inward slightly with building tension, then executes an explosive upward 'fist pump' movement, holding briefly at the peak. It follows with small, rapid celebratory shakes before concluding with a gentle, proud outward sweep and a relaxed, slightly lowered posture.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot arm starts at a ready position near the chest, pulls back slightly to gather energy, then executes a sharp, powerful downward pump, followed by a slight rebound and settling into a firm, decisive position.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot arm moves from a relaxed forward position, flexing its elbow sharply to bring the gripper up towards the shoulder, holding the pose to emphasize strength, and then gently releasing to a confident, lowered position.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot positions its arm neutrally, makes a sharp upward and downward 'nod' movement to signify agreement, then settles into a slightly lowered, composed stance.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot arm positions its hand near its face, performs a vigorous lateral shaking motion to signify 'no', then gradually reduces the intensity before settling into a final, deliberate position.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot arm initiates from a neutral stance, then moves with rising intensity to raise and extend slightly, simultaneously rotating the gripper to face upwards, signifying 'I don't know' or uncertainty. After a brief hold at the peak, it smoothly eases back to a relaxed position.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot slowly raises its hand towards its left temple, performs a light scratching motion to signal confusion or pensiveness, and then slowly lowers its arm to a thoughtful, slightly retracted position.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot's arm and 'body' (via shoulder movements) lean forward slightly then gently tilt to one side, holding briefly to convey curiosity, before slowly returning to a thoughtful, near-neutral stance.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot arm moves from a contemplative stance, raises its hand to cover its face in a gesture of frustration or exasperation, holds the pose briefly, and then slowly lowers its arm to a defeated, slumped position.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot brings its hand inward towards its chest, points decisively, holds the position briefly, and then gently retracts to a settled position.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot arm extends forward in a sharp, assertive motion to point, holds the pointing gesture briefly for emphasis, and then smoothly relaxes to a slightly retracted position.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm, rotates its wrist to orient the 'palm' slightly downward, then performs a repeated inward curling motion to beckon, initially vigorous and then slowing, before retracting the arm.

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot arm moves from a slightly retracted position to a fully extended, palm-forward stance to signal 'stop', holding the pose with conviction before a controlled, subtle relaxation.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot's arm moves from a ready position to sharply raise an 'index finger' (gripper) upright near the chest/shoulder area, holds it firmly to signify importance or a pause, then smoothly lowers it to an attentive, settled posture.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot moves its gripper, simulating an index finger, towards its mouth area, gently touches its 'lips' and holds, then slowly withdraws to a settled position.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot moves its hand to the stomach area and performs a series of light, gentle patting motions, conveying a subtle sense of hunger, fullness, or contemplation.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot arm moves to its own upper arm/shoulder area and performs a rubbing motion, simulating the human gesture for cold discomfort.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot positions its hand near its face as if bothered by heat, then performs rapid fanning motions with decreasing intensity, and finally lowers the arm as if in relief or exhaustion.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot's arm starts in a relaxed posture, gently slumps to convey sleepiness, then slowly raises its hand to cover its 'mouth' as if yawning, holding the position before gently lowering its arm to a final, more settled and tired state.

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot's arm slowly lifts towards its left eye, gently rubs it with small, slow motions, then slowly lowers back to a slumped, tired resting position.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot leans its torso forward and slightly downward, performing a deep bow to convey apology or reverence. Its hand remains at its side, following the body's motion, before returning to a settled, solemn posture.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot arm moves to a mid-chest, slightly forward position, then performs two distinct, rapid wrist flexes to mimic the 'air quotes' gesture, concluding with a gentle lowering of the arm.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot arm moves precisely to its temple, performs several quick, deliberate taps, and then retracts to a composed resting position, conveying thoughtfulness or intelligence.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its arm and positions its gripper near the left temple, then performs fast, expressive wrist rotations, gradually slowing down before gently lowering the arm.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot's arm moves to position its gripper near its mouth, then performs a rapid, precise horizontal slide across the lips, mimicking the 'zipping' gesture, and finishes with a subtle 'lock' before retracting to a settled pose.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot's arm moves from a slightly outward position, sweeps across its chest, and holds a defensive posture for a moment, then slowly lowers and retracts.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot starts with its arm slightly forward, then deliberately moves its arm to place its 'hand' (gripper) on its right hip, holding the pose firmly before slightly relaxing and settling into a less rigid but still confident stance.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot initiates from a neutral stance, leans forward with a controlled movement, presenting its gripper horizontally as if offering open palms to signal engagement and interest, holds this receptive posture briefly, and then gently eases back into an attentive, slightly less forward position.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot starts in a neutral pose, then quickly pulls its body back while simultaneously raising its arm upward and outward, holding the pose in frozen surprise before slowly returning to a composed position.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot subtly recoils, then rapidly brings its hand to cover its mouth in an abrupt motion, holding the pose of surprise or realization, before slowly returning to a composed stance.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot brings its gripper 'palms' together at chest level in a gesture of gratitude, then executes a subtle, respectful bow while holding the 'palms pressed' position, concluding with a held, reverent posture.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot arm moves from a low, forward position up to chest height, simulating holding a glass for a toast. It includes a subtle upward flick for a 'clink', a brief hold, and a controlled descent to a confident settled pose.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot initiates from a neutral stance, performs a preparatory lift and extension, then swiftly moves to an open-palm, upward-facing 'high five' position, holds it with inviting confidence, and finally lowers its arm to a settled, relaxed state.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot arm starts raised high with the palm facing up, then pulls back slightly before swinging rapidly downward as if performing a high-five, and finally settles into a relaxed, lower position.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot's arm starts in a ready position, extends smoothly and confidently forward at chest height to signal an invitation for a fist bump, holds the pose briefly, and then gently retracts to a relaxed follow-through.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot arm moves its gripper (simulating a fist) towards its own chest/stomach area, performs two light tapping motions, and then withdraws to a relaxed position, mimicking a friendly fist bump.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot's arm sweeps back and upward to reach its own back, then performs a series of distinct pats, concluding with a gentle withdrawal to a satisfied pose.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot raises its arm and draws a clear circular path in the air with its gripper (as if with an index finger), first briskly then more slowly, before gently lowering the arm.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position, raises its flat hand to the left side of its throat, performs a swift horizontal slicing motion across the throat, briefly holds, and then slowly lowers and retracts the arm.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot arm moves to a position under the chin, orienting the back of its gripper towards the body. It then executes a swift, dismissive lateral swipe outwards, finishing with a casual lowering of the arm.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot positions its hand in a relaxed, hovering state, then performs a light, repetitive finger-drumming motion, typical of someone waiting or feeling bored. The motion starts subtly, peaks with faster, more frequent taps, and then gently fades as the arm settles.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot positions its arm, then swiftly rotates its wrist to turn the palm upwards while simultaneously curling its fingers inward, holding the receptive pose briefly before settling into a slightly relaxed, expectant position.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot arm starts in a neutral-forward position, then smoothly extends forward and upward, presenting its gripper (as an open palm) facing up. It holds this position steadily before gently retracting and lowering the arm to a relaxed, slightly forward pose.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot arm starts in a neutral position, then steadily raises upwards and outwards until the hand is positioned beside its head, holding the pose, and finally settling slightly lower while still elevated, conveying a gesture of surrender or resignation.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot starts in a ready pose, then rapidly raises its arm to cover its ears, holds the position with a slight slump, and finally slowly lowers the arm, conveying discomfort or unwillingness to listen.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot's arm starts in a neutral, slightly forward position, gracefully extends forward and upward, then sweeps wide and outward to both sides, pausing briefly in a broad, open-arm gesture, and finally gently settles back to a relaxed, inviting posture.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot slowly raises its arm from a relaxed forward position to a full overhead stretch, holds for a moment of relief, and then gently lowers it back to a settled, relaxed state.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot arm moves from a neutral position, smoothly ascending and retracting to form a precise salute at the forehead, holding the pose, and then calmly lowering back to a relaxed position.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot raises its arm to place its hand above its eyebrows as a visor, leaning slightly forward to suggest looking intently into the distance, then slowly lowers its arm.
